name: Beetlebrow Mothwick
description: Insects stippled like plates from an old field guide. Knows every one by name and calls them all darling.

designs.title: Stag Beetle
designs.description: A stag beetle pinned flat like a specimen, stipple shaded with solid black antlers.

designs.title: Hawk Moth
designs.description: A broad-winged moth with eyespots, each wing darkening in dots towards its edge.

designs.title: Honey Bee
designs.description: A honey bee from above, with a furred thorax, veined wings and three solid bands.

designs.title: Orb Spider
designs.description: A stippled spider marked with a pale star, sitting right in the middle of her web.

designs.title: Field Guide Dragonfly
designs.description: A dragonfly with every wing cell ruled in, its long body drawn segment by segment.

designs.title: Swallowtail
designs.description: A swallowtail butterfly with stippled veined wings and two long tails trailing below.
